photos.author: Ceescamel
assertions: Dark weathered brown-gray brick; restrained bell gable with scroll shoulders and rounded crown; projecting cream hoist beam.
Paired tall windows with three columns and three rows; paired shorter four-pane attic windows, single rectangular top opening.
Cream four-bay timber pui with left double doors, upper clerestories, geometric carved panels and right display; raised stone stoop with right flight and dark railing.
Small oval memorial cartouche centered between tall windows above pui.
photos.confidence: High for visible assemblies; metric spacing is inferred from native frontage.
